summary: Iteration 19 - Stripe Connect Express testing complete. Backend: 18/18 tests PASSED + 45/45 regression tests from iter16/17/18 PASSED. Frontend: All Stripe Connect UI states verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND: GET /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/status (fresh creator) - VERIFIED: Returns {connected:false, charges_enabled:false, payouts_enabled:false, details_submitted:false, requirements_due:[]}

BACKEND: POST /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/onboard - VERIFIED: Creates Express Account (country=FR, business_type=individual), returns {url: https://connect.stripe.com/setup/e/acct_*, expires_at, account_id: acct_*}
BACKEND: POST /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/onboard (second call) - VERIFIED: Reuses existing stripe_account_id, returns new onboarding link
BACKEND: GET /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/status (after onboard) - VERIFIED: Returns {connected:true, account_id:acct_*, charges_enabled:false, requirements_due:[15 items]}
BACKEND: POST /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/dashboard-link (before onboard complete) - VERIFIED: Returns 400 (no account) or 502 (account not active)
BACKEND: POST /api/payments/subscribe-bundle-stripe (creator without Connect) - VERIFIED: Returns direct_payout:false, session created without transfer_data
BACKEND: POST /api/payments/subscribe-bundle-stripe (creator with Connect initiated but not complete) - VERIFIED: Returns direct_payout:false (charges_enabled=false)
BACKEND: GET /api/creators/me/stripe-connect/status (fan user) - VERIFIED: Returns 403 or valid response if fan was converted to creator
BACKEND: Regression tests iter16/17/18 - ALL 45 TESTS PASSED

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Connect Express fully implemented and tested. Onboarding creates real Stripe Express accounts (acct_*). To test transfer_data with destination charges, need to manually set stripe_account_charges_enabled=true in DB for a creator, then call subscribe-bundle-stripe. The payment_transaction will have connect_account and application_fee_cents fields. Platform commission is 20% (CREATOR_PAYOUT_RATIO=0.80).
